entry.title: a small guide to ssh keys
entry.content:
I keep coming back to ssh keys, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Ssh keys shows up across linux work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
